title: Placement Officer
description:
We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Placement Officer who can build strong relationships with corporate HRs and actively create new job opportunities for Blitz Academy students.

The ideal candidate should be confident in chatting, calling, emailing, and communicating with company HRs and recruiters, understanding their hiring requirements, and converting those conversations into genuine job openings for our students.

This is a target-oriented corporate engagement role where your ability to build a strong employer network will directly contribute to student placements.

Key Responsibilities

Connect with company HRs, Talent Acquisition teams, recruiters, and hiring managers through LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email, phone calls, and other professional platforms.

Build and maintain a strong network of corporate hiring partners across relevant industries.

Regularly communicate with HRs to identify their current and upcoming hiring requirements.

Generate new job vacancies and placement opportunities for Blitz Academy students.

Share suitable student profiles/resumes with companies based on their requirements.

Coordinate interviews, assessments, recruitment drives, and selection processes.

Follow up consistently with HRs regarding submitted profiles and interview outcomes.

Maintain a database of companies, HR contacts, vacancies, interviews, and placement status.

Develop long-term relationships with companies for repeat hiring and continuous recruitment opportunities.

Coordinate with the academic and placement teams to understand student skills, course completion, and candidate availability.

Track placement opportunities from initial HR communication through to final selection.

Explore opportunities for campus recruitment, off-campus hiring, internships, apprenticeships, and entry-level positions.

Meet monthly placement and employer-engagement targets.

What We Are Looking For

Experience in placement, corporate relations, recruitment, HR, business development, or employer engagement will be an advantage.

Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in corporate networking may also be considered.

Excellent English communication skills, especially written communication.

Ability to professionally communicate with HRs through WhatsApp, LinkedIn, email, and phone.

Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills.

Good convincing and negotiation abilities.

Comfortable with targets and performance-driven work.

Good knowledge of LinkedIn, job portals, WhatsApp, email, and Excel/Google Sheets.

Ability to understand job descriptions and identify suitable opportunities for students.

Proactive attitude with a strong focus on generating results.

Pay: ₹16,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Business Systems Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

Role summary

The Senior Business Systems Analyst carries the analytical execution load of the program. The role works through the detail of the existing learning estate, prepares the analysis that supports rationalisation decisions, and executes the mapping, cleanup and validation activity that follows those decisions. This is a hands-on seat and the volume of detailed work sits here.

Key responsibilities

* Build and maintain the inventory of curricula, learning items, assignments and associated attributes for assigned functional areas.
* Perform detailed analysis to surface duplicates, outdated content, incomplete records, inactive items, dummy entries and administrative accounts.
* Prepare structured analysis packs that allow stakeholders to make migrate, consolidate, archive or retire decisions efficiently.
* Execute data mapping activity between source and target structures, working to the standards agreed for the program.
* Perform and evidence data cleanup and remediation activity ahead of migration.
* Support reconciliation, test execution and user acceptance testing, and capture the associated evidence.
* Maintain trackers, logs, templates and checklists to the standard set by the Lead BSA.
* Prepare recurring status, progress and exception reporting for the assigned functional area.
* Raise data quality concerns, anomalies and emerging risks promptly through the agreed channel.

Required experience

* 8+ years of business analysis, data analysis or systems analysis experience, including involvement in a system transition or data migration.
* Strong practical data-handling capability — comfortable working at volume with spreadsheets, extracts, structured queries and reporting output.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently through detailed, high-volume analytical work with accuracy and consistency.
* Experience preparing documentation, trackers and templates to a standard suitable for a regulated environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort operating with stakeholders in a different time zone.
* Willingness to work a dedicated shift pattern providing overlap with US Eastern business hours.
* Experience working within GxP-regulated environments.

Preferred experience

* Exposure to a learning management system, enterprise HR platform or comparable enterprise application.
* Experience in a regulated industry, ideally life sciences or pharmaceutical.
* Experience supporting testing and validation cycles.

Ways of working

* Works to the direction and priorities set by the assigned Client workstream lead or program owner.
* Maintains transparent, timely status against assigned activities and escalates blockers early rather than at the point of impact.
* Documents decisions, actions and open items so that context is held in the program record and not solely with the individual.
* Cross-trains across adjacent functional areas to provide coverage redundancy within the Milestone team.

Compliance and environment

* Works entirely within Client's systems, tools and environments. No client data is moved to, stored in or processed on external tooling without Client's express written approval.
* Operates within a GxP-regulated environment and follows Client's data privacy, data integrity, information security and records-retention standards at all times.
* Completes all Client-mandated onboarding, access provisioning and compliance training before commencing project activity.

Participates in Milestone's structured program induction covering program context, stakeholder map, ways of working and tooling

**Compensation**
----------------

Estimated Pay Range:  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.*

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.*  
  
*We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

title: COO - Club Oxygen
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Head of Hospitality** to lead and oversee the Group's hospitality business with complete responsibility for **business performance, operations, profitability, people, customer experience, expansion, and strategic growth**.

The ideal candidate should have strong **CEO / COO / Business Head / General Management experience**, with the ability to manage complex operations, build high\-performing teams, improve business performance, and drive sustainable growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide overall strategic and operational leadership for the hospitality division.
* Take ownership of **revenue, profitability, cost control, service quality, and business growth**.
* Develop and execute short\-term and long\-term business strategies.
* Oversee hospitality properties, restaurants, resorts, and related operations.
* Establish systems, processes, SOPs, and performance standards across operations.
* Identify opportunities for **business expansion, new properties, new concepts, and strategic partnerships**.
* Monitor financial performance, budgets, cash flows, margins, and operational costs.
* Build, develop, and retain strong leadership teams across functions.
* Establish performance\-driven management systems and accountability at all levels.
* Drive customer experience, service standards, brand positioning, and guest satisfaction.
* Work closely with Finance, HR, Marketing, Projects, Procurement, and other corporate functions.
* Review business performance through regular MIS, KPIs, and management reports and take corrective actions where required.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement measures to improve productivity and profitability.
* Represent the hospitality business before key stakeholders, partners, vendors, and external agencies.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, regulatory, safety, and operational requirements.
* Act as a strategic advisor to Group Management on hospitality investments, opportunities, and business decisions.

**Candidate Profile**

* **15\+ years of overall professional experience**, with significant experience in senior leadership roles.
* Experience as **CEO, COO, Business Head, Executive Director, General Manager, or equivalent senior management position** is preferred.
* Candidates with experience across **multiple industries**, particularly hospitality, retail, FMCG, services, tourism, real estate, or other consumer\-facing businesses, may be considered.
* Strong understanding of **P\&L management, business strategy, operations, people management, sales, and commercial decision\-making**.
* Proven experience managing large teams and multi\-unit / multi\-location operations.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, communication, analytical, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to operate at both **strategic and execution levels**.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong focus on business growth and profitability.
* Graduate degree is required; **MBA / equivalent management qualification is preferred**.

Work Location: In person
